author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Curb Your Enthusiasm didn't just have a great pilot. It may have had the perfect pilot.

Coming off of Seinfeld, Larry David had an almost impossible task: create another cult comedy that could live up to the legacy of one of television's biggest sitcoms while somehow making it feel completely different.

And yet, the very first episode of Curb Your Enthusiasm somehow establishes almost everything that would make the series work for another two decades.

Because Curb Your Enthusiasm may look chaotic on the surface.  But underneath all that awkwardness is an incredibly precise comedy machine.

#curbyourenthusiasm #seinfeld #larrydavid #hbo
title: How Larry David Created The PERFECT Pilot
